subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Explorar ambientes virtuais de informação e socialização, analisando a qualidade e a validade das informações veiculadas.

components.description_pt: Localizar informações em ambientes virtuais e redes sociais
components.description_en: Locate information in virtual environments and social networks
components.cc_component_description: Use text features to locate information relevant to a specific topic efficiently

components.description_pt: Avaliar a qualidade e confiabilidade de informações encontradas em fontes digitais
components.description_en: Evaluate the quality and reliability of information found in digital sources
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the credibility and relevance of information from multiple sources in diverse formats

components.description_pt: Distinguir informações válidas de inválidas ou enganosas em contextos online
components.description_en: Distinguish valid from invalid or misleading information in online contexts
components.cc_component_description: Analyze relevant information to support or revise claims using valid and reliable evidence

components.description_pt: Analisar como ambientes de redes sociais moldam a circulação de informações
components.description_en: Analyze how social networking environments shape the circulation of information
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how the choice of medium influences the clarity and impact of information

cc_matches.description: Use text features and search tools (e.g., key words, sidebars, hyperlinks) to locate information relevant to a given topic efficiently.

Multilingual learners will interpret social studies arguments by
* Identifying topic and purpose (argue in favor of or against a position, present a balanced interpretation, challenge perspective)
* Analyzing relevant information to support and/or __revise__ claims with __valid and reliable__ evidence from multiple sources
* Evaluating credibility, __accuracy, and relevancy__ of source based on __expert perspectives__
Integrate and evaluate multiple sources of information presented in diverse formats and media (e.g., quantitative data, video, multimedia) in order to address a question or solve a problem.
Evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of using different mediums (e.g., print or digital text, video, multimedia) to present a particular topic or idea.
